4800: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Raise until your torso and thighs are level like a tabletop.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your head in line with your spine.
Hold briefly, then lower your hips back to the floor under control.
4801: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.
4802: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.
4803: Set up with a barbell held at arm's length above your head, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep your elbows from flaring out.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the start.
4804: Hold a barbell at arm's length over your chest, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your elbows tucked.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when the bar is low.
Extend your arms to return the bar to the start.
4805: Stand with feet well wider than your shoulders and toes angled out.
Raise your arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
4806: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.
4807: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.
4808: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
4810: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
4811: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your neck neutral and your core tight.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.
4812: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
4816: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
Drive through your heels to stand.
4817: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.
4818: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.
4819: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.
4820: Set up in a push-up position with your feet in the ring straps.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders over your hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Pause with your hips lifted and abs tight.
Extend your legs back to a straight plank slowly.
4821: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Press through that heel to stand up on the bench.
Lower your other foot back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
4822: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and jump as you shrug your shoulders.
Reset into the hinge and repeat.
4824: Stand in an athletic stance with your fists up.
Rotate your hips and torso as you throw a punch across your body.
Extend your arm fully and pivot your back foot.
Alternate sides at a brisk, controlled pace.
4825: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended out wide.
Gently lift your chest off the floor.
Draw your shoulder blades together and back.
Keep your neck in a neutral position.
4826: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.
4829: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.
4830: Kneel and sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Place your hands on the floor at chest height.
Shift forward and lower your chest between your hands.
Push the floor away to rise.
Sit back to the starting pose and repeat.
4831: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.
4832: Lie face down on a bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
4833: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing you.
Brace your core and keep your other arm at your side.
Press the dumbbell up while rotating your palm to face forward.
Lower while rotating back, then switch sides.
4834: Sit on a stability ball holding dumbbells and walk out until your upper back rests on it.
Lift your hips so your body forms a bridge.
Press one dumbbell up over your chest.
Lower it slowly while keeping your hips steady.
4835: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing each other.
Press the weights up while turning your palms to face forward.
Reach full arm extension over your chest.
Lower the weights while rotating back to a neutral grip.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades tight.
4836: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells together over your chest with a reverse (palms toward you) grip.
Lower them to your chest with elbows close to your body.
Press back up, keeping the squeeze.
4837: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your reps.
4838: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
4839: Lie on your back with a band around your feet and legs bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg away against the band.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
4840: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.
4841: Attach a band to the barbell and anchor it overhead or to a rack.
Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away to lift.
Stand tall and lock out your hips.
4842: Attach bands to the trap bar and stand inside the bar.
Grip the handles with a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Lock your hips out at the top against the band.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
4843: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Immediately explode forward into a broad jump.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.
4844: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Rebound immediately into a maximum vertical jump.
Spend as little time on the ground as you can.
Land softly and reset for the next rep.
4845: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the kettlebells up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
4846: Lie on the floor and hold a kettlebell upside down in one hand.
Keep your wrist straight and the bell steady.
Press it up to full extension.
Lower slowly until your upper arm touches the floor.
4847: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise the plate up and overhead.
4848: Set pins at the bottom depth and place the bar on them.
Get under the bar in a front rack position.
Brace and drive up to stand.
Lower back to the pins under control.
4849: Set up on a glute-ham bench or anchor your feet with a band assisting you.
Start with your torso down and hips locked.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
4850: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg.
Keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower until your torso is near parallel.
Return and switch legs after your reps.
4851: Set the pins to a hip-hinge height and set the bar on them.
Get under the bar, brace and unrack.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Return the bar to the pins.
4852: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
4853: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or sides.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Push off to return and switch sides.
4854: Sit on the floor with legs bent and a bar across your shoulders.
Rotate your torso to one side.
4855: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side.
4856: Set the bar on pins at chest height.
Lie on the bench and grip the bar shoulder-width.
4857: Hold a barbell on your upper back with a wide grip.
Drive up explosively and press overhead.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.
4858: Step your hands and feet to the side.
4859: Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
4860: Drive one knee toward your chest.
4861: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs.
4862: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at your thighs.
Stand tall with your chest up.
4863: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
4864: Stand on a low platform with a wide stance and toes out.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away.
4865: Hold dumbbells overhead with locked arms.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Step through into the next lunge.
4866: Sit on the floor with legs straight and the bar at your shoulders.
4867: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Gently flap your knees up and down.
4870: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
4871: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them to the side and lower.
Raise them to the front and lower.
Then bend forward and raise them out to the rear.
Complete all six variations as one rep.
4875: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and press your arms forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin slightly.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades and along the spine.
4876: Stand or sit tall and press your palms together at chest height.
Point your fingers up and keep your elbows out.
Push your palms firmly into each other.
Relax and shake out your arms.
4880: Lie on your back with legs raised slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch and cross the other way.
4881: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high, open both knees out to the sides.
Bring the knees back together without dropping the hips.
Lower slowly to the floor and repeat.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.
4882: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
4883: Lie on your back with your hands by your head or at your sides.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bicycle.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Breathe steadily and keep a smooth rhythm.
Lower your legs and rest when your form slips.
4884: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
4885: Lie back on an incline surface and hold the top with your hands.
Bring your legs up with knees slightly bent.
Curl your pelvis and lift your hips off the surface.
Pause with your feet pointing toward the ceiling.
4886: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or under your hips.
Raise your legs so they point to the ceiling.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips a few centimetres.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep the motion small and controlled.
4887: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on each hip and hold them in place.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
4888: Stand with feet wide and press a dumbbell overhead with one arm.
Turn your feet slightly away from the weighted side.
Push your hips toward the weighted side and hinge forward.
Slide your free hand down your leg while your eyes stay on the dumbbell.
Reverse the movement to stand tall again.
Keep the arm locked and stacked over your shoulder, then switch sides.
4889: Stand over the dumbbells with feet hip width and grab them with a flat back.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees fast.
Shrug and pull the dumbbells up close to your body.
Drop under them and catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower with control to the floor.
Keep your back flat and the weights close throughout.
4890: Set up on the glute ham bench with your ankles locked in and thighs supported.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid arching your lower back.
4891: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
4892: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
4893: Kneel facing the cable stack and hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Let the hands rise only halfway, keeping tension.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.
4894: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
4895: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.
4896: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
4897: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.
4898: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Kick one leg out to the side at the top.
Land softly on both feet with soft knees.
4899: Load the machine and set your chest against the support.
Grab the wide handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, elbows flaring out.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.
